Left and Right change the volume in step.en: Left and Right change the volume in steps of 5 percent. Enter mutes it, or sets it to 50 percent when muted.
Left and Right change the volume in step.ja: 左右で音量を5%ずつ変更。Enterでミュート、ミュート中なら50%に設定。
Left and Right change the volume in step.fr: Gauche et droite changent le volume par paliers de 5 %. Entrée coupe le son, ou le règle à 50 % s'il est coupé.
Left and Right change the volume in step.it: Sinistra e destra cambiano il volume a passi del 5%. Invio lo silenzia, o lo imposta al 50% se è silenziato.
Left and Right change the volume in step.de: Links und rechts ändern die Lautstärke in 5-Prozent-Schritten. Eingabe schaltet stumm oder setzt sie, wenn stumm, auf 50 Prozent.
Left and Right change the volume in step.es: Izquierda y derecha cambian el volumen en pasos del 5 %. Intro lo silencia, o lo pone al 50 % si está silenciado.
Left and Right change the volume in step.ko: 좌우로 음량을 5%씩 변경합니다. Enter로 음소거하며, 음소거 상태에서는 50%로 설정합니다.
Left and Right change the volume in step.zht: 左右以5%為單位調整音量。Enter靜音；靜音時則設為50%。
Left and Right change the volume in step.zhc: 左右以5%为单位调整音量。Enter静音；静音时则设为50%。
Left and Right change the volume in step.ru: Влево и вправо меняют громкость с шагом 5 процентов. Enter выключает звук, а если он выключен, ставит 50 процентов.
Left and Right change the volume in step.th: ซ้ายขวาเปลี่ยนระดับเสียงทีละ 5 เปอร์เซ็นต์ Enter เพื่อปิดเสียง หรือตั้งเป็น 50 เปอร์เซ็นต์เมื่อปิดเสียงอยู่
Left and Right change the volume in step.pt: Esquerda e direita mudam o volume em passos de 5%. Enter silencia, ou define em 50% se estiver silenciado.

On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.en: On. Tones sound toward any wall right next to you.
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.ja: オン。すぐ隣の壁の方向から音が鳴ります。
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.fr: Activé. Un son indique la direction de tout mur juste à côté de vous.
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.it: Attivato. Un suono indica la direzione di ogni muro subito accanto a te.
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.de: Ein. Ein Ton erklingt in Richtung jeder direkt angrenzenden Wand.
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.es: Activado. Suena un tono hacia cualquier pared justo a tu lado.
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.ko: 켜짐. 바로 옆에 있는 벽 방향에서 소리가 납니다.
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.zht: 開啟。緊鄰的牆壁方向會發出音效。
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.zhc: 开启。紧邻的墙壁方向会发出音效。
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.ru: Вкл. Звук раздаётся со стороны любой стены рядом с вами.
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.th: เปิด มีเสียงดังจากทิศของกำแพงที่อยู่ติดกับคุณ
On. Tones sound toward any wall right ne.pt: Ligado. Um som toca na direção de qualquer parede logo ao seu lado.

On. A click plays for every tile you mov.it: Attivato. Un clic suona per ogni casella percorsa.
On. A click plays for every tile you mov.de: Ein. Bei jedem Feld, das du gehst, ertönt ein Klick.
On. A click plays for every tile you mov.es: Activado. Suena un clic por cada casilla que avanzas.

On. A click plays for every tile you mov.ru: Вкл. Щелчок звучит на каждой пройденной клетке.
On. A click plays for every tile you mov.th: เปิด มีเสียงคลิกทุกครั้งที่เดินหนึ่งช่อง

On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.en: On. Choosing a destination starts an audio beacon instead of spoken directions.
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.ja: オン。目的地を選ぶと、音声による道案内の代わりにビーコン音が鳴ります。
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.fr: Activé. Choisir une destination lance une balise sonore au lieu d'indications vocales.
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.it: Attivato. Scegliere una destinazione avvia un segnale audio invece delle indicazioni vocali.
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.de: Ein. Die Wahl eines Ziels startet ein Audiosignal statt gesprochener Wegbeschreibung.
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.es: Activado. Al elegir un destino suena una baliza de audio en lugar de indicaciones habladas.
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.ko: 켜짐. 목적지를 고르면 음성 길 안내 대신 오디오 비콘이 울립니다.
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.zht: 開啟。選擇目的地時會播放音訊信標，而不是語音指引。
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.zhc: 开启。选择目的地时会播放音频信标，而不是语音指引。
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.ru: Вкл. При выборе цели включается звуковой маяк вместо голосовых указаний.
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.th: เปิด เมื่อเลือกจุดหมายจะมีสัญญาณเสียงแทนการบอกทางด้วยเสียงพูด
On. Choosing a destination starts an aud.pt: Ligado. Escolher um destino inicia um sinal de áudio em vez de instruções faladas.

Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.en: Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-by-step directions.
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.ja: オフ。目的地を選ぶと、道順を読み上げます。
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.fr: Désactivé. Choisir une destination énonce l'itinéraire pas à pas.
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.it: Disattivato. Scegliere una destinazione legge il percorso passo per passo.
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.de: Aus. Die Wahl eines Ziels liest den Weg Schritt für Schritt vor.
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.es: Desactivado. Al elegir un destino se leen las indicaciones paso a paso.
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.ko: 꺼짐. 목적지를 고르면 단계별 길 안내를 읽어 줍니다.
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.zht: 關閉。選擇目的地時會逐步朗讀路線。
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.zhc: 关闭。选择目的地时会逐步朗读路线。
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.ru: Выкл. При выборе цели маршрут зачитывается пошагово.
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.th: ปิด เมื่อเลือกจุดหมายจะอ่านเส้นทางทีละขั้น
Off. Choosing a destination speaks step-.pt: Desligado. Escolher um destino lê o caminho passo a passo.

On. Restarting the beacon also speaks th.en: On. Restarting the beacon also speaks the destination.
On. Restarting the beacon also speaks th.ja: オン。ビーコンを再開すると目的地も読み上げます。
On. Restarting the beacon also speaks th.fr: Activé. Relancer la balise énonce aussi la destination.
On. Restarting the beacon also speaks th.it: Attivato. Riavviare il segnale legge anche la destinazione.
On. Restarting the beacon also speaks th.de: Ein. Beim Neustart des Signals wird auch das Ziel angesagt.
On. Restarting the beacon also speaks th.es: Activado. Reiniciar la baliza también dice el destino.
On. Restarting the beacon also speaks th.ko: 켜짐. 비콘을 다시 시작하면 목적지도 읽어 줍니다.
On. Restarting the beacon also speaks th.zht: 開啟。重新啟動信標時也會播報目的地。
On. Restarting the beacon also speaks th.zhc: 开启。重新启动信标时也会播报目的地。
On. Restarting the beacon also speaks th.ru: Вкл. При перезапуске маяка также называется цель.
On. Restarting the beacon also speaks th.th: เปิด เมื่อเริ่มสัญญาณใหม่จะบอกจุดหมายด้วย
On. Restarting the beacon also speaks th.pt: Ligado. Reiniciar o sinal também anuncia o destino.

Off. Restarting the beacon only pings..ja: オフ。ビーコンを再開しても音が鳴るだけです。

Off. Restarting the beacon only pings..zht: 關閉。重新啟動信標時只會發出提示音。
Off. Restarting the beacon only pings..zhc: 关闭。重新启动信标时只会发出提示音。
Off. Restarting the beacon only pings..ru: Выкл. При перезапуске маяка звучит только сигнал.
Off. Restarting the beacon only pings..th: ปิด เมื่อเริ่มสัญญาณใหม่จะมีแค่เสียงสัญญาณ
Off. Restarting the beacon only pings..pt: Desligado. Reiniciar o sinal só emite o bipe.

On. L3 and R3 go to the game; their mod.es: Activado. L3 y R3 van al juego; sus funciones del mod pasan al modo mod.

On. Menu entries end with their position.de: Ein. Menüeinträge enden mit ihrer Position, zum Beispiel 3 von 12.

On. Descriptions are read as soon as an.th: เปิด อ่านคำอธิบายทันทีเมื่อเลือกไอเท็ม เวทมนตร์ หรือสินค้าในร้าน

On. Exits leading to the same place are.es: Activado. Las salidas que llevan al mismo lugar se agrupan en la más cercana.

On. Exits leading to the same place are.pt: Ligado. Saídas que levam ao mesmo lugar são reunidas na mais próxima.
